theorems.name: Submission.dmcbr_ci_pw_blowup_lower_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (η₀ θ₀ : ℝ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P (d + 1)) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)), (∀ (C' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)), C'.boundary = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → C'.massOn W = μ W) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), C' ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P d), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), C' ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, (C').boundary η = ∫ x, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → ∀ (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), LipschitzWith L f → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (B : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), A ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, B η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A.boundary - B)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ENNReal.ofReal η₀ ≤ liminf (fun r : ℝ => μ (ball x r) / (unitBallVolume (d + 1) * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (d + 1)))) (𝓝[>] 0)) → 0 < θ₀ → C.boundary = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → C.massOn W = ENNReal.ofReal θ₀ * ν W) → (∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ζ₀ β| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), C ω = ∫ y, θ₀ * ζ₀ ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) y) ∂ν) → (∀ (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P d), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), C ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, (C).boundary η = ∫ x, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → ∀ (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), LipschitzWith L f → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (B : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), A ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, B η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A.boundary - B)) → ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, ENNReal.ofReal (η₀ / θ₀) ≤ liminf (fun r : ℝ => ν (ball y r) / (unitBallVolume (d + 1) * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (d + 1)))) (𝓝[>] 0)
